subject: Implement session_new / session_status / session_clear NL agent tools
description:
Build `capo/tools/session.py` and register `session_new`, `session_status`, `session_clear` as Pydantic AI agent tools so the agent can route natural-language equivalents to the same actions as the slash commands. Implementation reuses the same code paths to keep behavior consistent.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `session_new`, `session_status`, `session_clear` registered with the agent.
- [ ] Tools call into the same backend functions as the slash commands (single source of truth).
- [ ] Tool docstrings make NL routing intent unambiguous to the model.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] If user message matches a slash command, the slash parser handles it (zero tokens) — these tools only fire for NL routing.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: each tool returns the same shape as its slash command counterpart
• Integration: NL prompt "start a fresh chat" routes to `session_new`

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.10, 9.5
